couple.heading: Two Hearts, One Sacred Journey
couple.intro: With hearts full of gratitude, Chinmay and Khushi invite you to celebrate the beginning of their beautiful forever.
couple.groomParents: Son of Mr. Vijay Kumar Jain & Mrs. Rinku Jain
couple.groomAboutText: Grounded in family values and gratitude, Chinmay looks forward to beginning this new chapter surrounded by the love and blessings of those closest to him.
couple.brideParents: Daughter of Mr. Vinod Jain & Mrs. Sunita Jain
couple.brideAboutText: With a joyful heart and a deep connection to her loved ones, Khushi warmly welcomes this cherished new beginning and the memories it will bring.

events.title: Celebration Itinerary & Events
events.subtitle: A majestic two-day affair honoring sacred Vedic rituals, high-spirited music, and grand celebrations in Uttar Pradesh on December 04–05, 2026.
events.tikkaDesc: Intricate henna designs, traditional welcome blessings, and shagun exchange for the bride and family.
events.ringDesc: A joyous exchange of rings binding two hearts with the blessings of both families.
events.haldiDesc: The bride and groom are anointed with turmeric paste for radiance and blessings.
events.sangeetDesc: Music, dance, and celebration with both families under the stars.
events.vidhanDesc: Sacred Vedic rituals performed to seek divine blessings for the union.
events.baraatDesc: The groom arrives with his family and friends in a joyful procession.
events.varmalaDesc: The bride and groom exchange flower garlands, marking the acceptance of the union.
events.hastMelapDesc: Sacred ceremony of joining hands and taking seven vows around the holy fire.
